Subject: Re: Diego Santana — scorecard and quick debrief ask

Recommend: follow-up task (30–45m) — conditional hire.

Rationale: Diego has strong systems design instincts (4/5 on the rubric) and a solid track record on throughput tuning. The panel flagged two recurring themes: (1) unfamiliarity with our KV-cache eviction nuance that led to an early off-by-one in the whiteboard exercise; (2) slower-than-expected debugging on a short live-coding problem that probed edge cases. Both feel addressable with a short, bookended exercise: give him a small repro that includes a subtle cache eviction bug and ask for root-cause + patch; then a 10–15m discussion on verification and rollout plan.

Attachment: interview-notes-ds.docx (internal notes — short bullets)

Marcus

marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Diego Santana — scorecard and quick debrief ask

Agree with Marcus — lean follow-up task.

One caution: Diego's behavioural notes show a pattern of defensiveness when challenged on assumptions. If we do the follow-up, include a ~5m behavioral prompt that observes how he takes feedback on his proposed fix. That will be our signal for collaborating under ambiguity.

Mina Haddad
Manager, Applied ML — Inference Optimizations
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Diego Santana — scorecard and quick debrief ask

Vote: follow-up task — yes.

Tie-breaker note: panel scores are borderline (average 3.3/5). If we ask for a task, make it synchronous (30–45m) with Marcus running the debugging exercise and Mina observing the behavioral prompt. If he passes, I back hire; if borderline again, we tabletop a sandbox trial (contract to perm).

Connor Obrien
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Diego Santana — scorecard and quick debrief ask

Thanks all — consensus: follow-up synchronous task (30–45m). Marcus to own the technical repro + live debug, Mina to lead the 5m behavioral probe. Connor will be second interviewer.

Leah — can you schedule a 1-hour slot next week (include buffer) and share the proposed time with Diego? We want the live session to be within the next 5 business days. If Diego is unavailable for a live session, propose a short take-home task but note we prefer live for these clues.

I'll prep a short rubric for the exercise and drop in the candidate record: https://redwood-inference.app/records/candidates/DS-3412

Next steps:
- Marcus: draft repro & rubric by Wed COB (I'll post in the candidate doc)
- Leah: schedule session w/in 5 business days
- Mina: prepare behavioral prompt (5m)
